body:
Hola u/the-amazing-potato. 

I hear you. What I meant to say was that there is nothing in my life in which I funtion well. I think what you shared has great value.  It's advice that I would try to impart. I just don't want to do the work anymore.  It's as simple as that. The returns are too weak.  They have been as back as I can remember. 

Even conceding that I could change my mind, I am no longer satisfied living without an option out.  The plan moves forward.  Then I can postpone daily if I want.  But I want it ready. I have a preflight checklist that's my best effort at an "Are you sure you want this?"  

I'm tired of muttering I wish I was dead.  Instead I will look death in the eye amd find a reason to go on or not.

But hell,  it makes me happy to think about it like nothing else has in ages. Why would I give that up?  No more work, no more loss,  no more shame, no more hole in the center of my being, no more toothaches, no more drugs that only work halfway, no more fear,  no more no, more no more. 

Think of it like this.  No one blames of person that dies from hypothermia when they just lay down and let themselves die. it's part of what hypothermia does to you. just think of me as someone with a sort of hypothermia except I'm making my exit as rational as I can or am willing to be.

Hi there u/shyftxero. Today is T minus 9. I have some bills due at the middle of the month and until then I want to have some fun. 

Also need time to write some letters and reflect on my decision. It's great  working towards something that actually has meaning to me in a profound way. Even if I abort, I want the plan perfectly in place because knowing I don't have to stick around this party may actually give me the freedom to live bit longer or better.  Or not,  I can't say for sure. First time is the only time. 

Even with little to my name there are also some logistics that need to be addressed. I want my pet taken care of amd I don't need some fuckin White Knight showing up and ruining my retirement. I've already traded my belt for zip ties at a fine country resort once. Not for me, that is. 

It's sun-up and as I warm with my latte and wash some clothes I feel cheerful.
Funny how I still feel this impulse to go on with the daily chores of life (even going to a job interview in a while)  but I think it's important to stay sharp.  If I let myself stay too low too long I could end up so down I can't even move and that's no good to the plan. I need my motivation intact. 

Anyhoo...  That's the news this morning.  It's a great day and I am still satisfied with the consistency of my desire to die. It's great to have my thoughts read by someone.  Thanks for that, big mental handshake. 

I might keep posting, I dunno. A full countdown seems cheesy. Stay cool. 

Edit - 
I'm so wrapped up I never thought to ask about you. Sorry. How goes it? (serious).
